status: adopted 2026-10-25 by the research owner under maintainer handoff, before any reference or comparative outcome

binary.build: one job builds the qualified e3 and the worker binary, reruns worker-validation contract v2 and reference_validation.py on those exact bytes, then publishes the worker binary as a 90-day Actions artifact with manifest and reports
binary.use: every reference and execution job downloads it and verifies SHA-256; execution freeze binds the hash

roles.references: worker DUMP request (Film GetPixelRGB, full float precision, no per-sample logs)

binary.portable: built with PBRT_BUILD_NATIVE_EXECUTABLE=OFF (no -march=native) after run 40164652532: a binary built on EPYC 9V74 died with an illegal instruction before rendering on EPYC 7763 runners; validations run on the portable bytes

host: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 standard runners (public repository, free)

job_layout.job: one unit (scene, frame, replicate) x one timing repeat
job_layout.policies_per_job: all six, sequential, registered timing-order permutation for the unit and repeat
job_layout.workers: two persistent workers (allocation, production), 1 PBRT thread each, concurrent
job_layout.hardware_disclosure: lscpu per job; report units whose repeats span CPU models and a single-model sensitivity (reported, not gating)

references.producer: reference_producer.py: worker DUMP request (Film GetPixelRGB at full float precision, no per-sample logs), 4 threads, registered stream identity and seed, full prefix [0,spp), converted exactly to canonical float64 npy
references.producer_validation: reference_validation.py on non-primary fixtures at 1 and 4 threads, per-pixel equality with per-sample means within the frozen E2 tolerance
references.matrix: 30 frames x 2 streams at 8192 spp; corpus verified by reference_pipeline.corpus_plans in every job
references.escalation: 8192 -> 16384 -> 32768, regenerate full prefix, retain every level; halt at 32768 per protocol
references.precision_disclosure: Film float32 values, relative rounding about 6e-8
references.revision: 2026-10-25 before any reference: PFM path replaced after producer validation run 40125241618 failed (PBRT RGB film image output is half precision); worker-validation contract v2 adds exact DUMP equivalence

cap.calibration: uniform policy, worker + cached kernel, non-primary throughput-256 fixture, hosted runner, to A_u + 2^26, three repeats
cap.rule: C = 2 x median calibrated wall time, rounded up to a whole minute; bound in the execution freeze

per_job_scoring: offline after each policy run: snapshots scored against the frame scoring reference (relative MSE, SSIM, LPIPS, worst 16x16 region) with the pinned metric stack; keep four checkpoint images, scores, hashes, run record and decision trace; discard snapshot images
determinism_check: checkpoint image hashes identical across a unit's three repeats; mismatch is a correctness failure blocking PASS
